notes: The program named is 'Asian Engine Performance Technology' (closed list AUTO 749 Asian Engine Performance), but the catalog page (URL and text) is for Automotive Advanced Engine Performance Technology with AUTO 752 Advanced Engine Performance. The page may be the wrong program; reviewer should verify.

No explicit award heading is printed in the extracted text; the leading '20 units' and 'Certificate of Specialization ... Automotive Technician - Entry Level 7 units' lines appear to be fragments of an award menu and were not read as requirements.

The fundamentals requirement is AUTO 710, or AUTO 711, or AUTO 509.1 AND AUTO 509.2 together; AUTO 509.1 and 509.2 are recorded as alternatives of AUTO 710 but must be taken as a pair (5 units combined).

Footnote: the AUTO 710/711/509.1+509.2 requirement may also be met by one year of high school automotive, one year of verifiable work experience, or an automotive fundamentals course from an accredited community college program, combined with passing the AUTO 710 credit by exam test.
The certificate can only be completed by students admitted to the Automotive Technology program through special application approval.
Program Learning Outcomes are printed for this program as a whole and recorded for this certificate.
